resources.string: Ask for the card security code
This engine build does not support filling security codes yet. You can enter the CVV directly in the payment form. Midori never saves it.
Enter the CVV for each payment. Midori sends it only to the form you choose to fill and never saves or syncs it.

Send crashes, app freezes, recoverable storage, sync and download errors, and performance data to Sentry. Reports identify the affected operation without passwords, payment data, or visited addresses.
